title: docs(north-star): the road grades a wrong-result run by Priority rule 2; rule 3 does not hold the p2 pm:blocking card that unblocks the lane's P0/P1

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:北极星「the road」段那句「跑通但结果错为 P2」改成指向〈Priority〉第 2 条定级,不再自带级别;〈Priority〉第 3 条加一个豁免:车道有未派 P0/P1 时,该 P0/P1 在 `Blocked-by:` 行点名的 p2 `pm:blocking` 卡照常派发;读第 3 条扣卡的两处(`execution-duties.md` 取卡前置、`triage-duties.md` 三门皆无的 `tooling` 卡首触即关)都加了指向豁免的说明。
- 为什么改:您在 #32997 的两条裁决「「the road」段仍写「跑通但结果错为 P2」，与 Priority 新的「数据静默错或丢为 P1」不一致，要改」与「Priority 第 3 条「车道有未派 P0/P1 时不派 p2/p3 工具卡」，现在也会挡住替它解锁的 p2 `pm:blocking` 工具卡，要豁免」。
- 风险与回滚:纯文字,4 行改 4 行;没有脚本实现第 3 条的扣卡(已 grep 核实),所以行为只经席位读规则改变;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 第 116 行(第 3 条豁免的措辞),再看第 11 行与 `triage-duties.md` 第 63 行。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- docs/NORTH-STAR.md`,预期只见第 11 行末句改为指向 "Priority" rule 2、第 116 行多一个 except 从句。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

- **`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` "The one measure: the road" (line 11).** "one that runs through but gives a wrong result is P2" becomes "one that runs through but gives a wrong result is graded by "Priority" rule 2". The road now points at rule 2 (data silently wrong or lost is P1 subject to the reach discount; any other wrong run is P2) instead of restating a grade, so the two cannot drift again.
- **`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 〈Priority〉 rule 3 (line 116).** The hold gains its one exemption, stated once: "…dispatches no p2/p3 tooling card or contract-hygiene card, except a p2 `pm:blocking` card that such a P0/P1 names on its `Blocked-by:` line, which is not held because it unblocks that P0/P1". A p2 `pm:blocking` card that blocks only other cards is still held.
- **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` line 50**, the take precondition that reads rule 3's hold: 「第 3 条」 becomes 「第 3 条(含豁免)」, a pointer rather than a copy. To stay inside the 120-byte line cap, 「每次取卡现读」 becomes 「取卡时现读」 (same reading: live at every take). 110 to 118 bytes, line count unchanged (190, ceiling 190).
- **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` line 63**, the second reader of the hold: triage's first-touch close of a p2/p3 `tooling` card with none of the three doors while the lane's P0/P1 is undispatched. Its doors key on the blocker's own `Unblocks:` line, the exemption on the dependent's `Blocked-by:` line, so without a pointer triage would close the very card rule 3 now exempts. The line now ends 「「Priority」第 3 条豁免除外」; to pay for it inside 120 bytes, 「P0/P1 开着(= 未派发,在飞不算)时」 becomes 「P0/P1 未派时」, the same definition execution-duties.md line 51 states. 110 to 120 bytes, line count unchanged (101, ceiling 101).

## Why

The maintainer's ruling on #32997 (comment 6867138933), verbatim:

1. 「「the road」段仍写「跑通但结果错为 P2」，与 Priority 新的「数据静默错或丢为 P1」不一致，要改」
2. 「Priority 第 3 条「车道有未派 P0/P1 时不派 p2/p3 工具卡」，现在也会挡住替它解锁的 p2 `pm:blocking` 工具卡，要豁免」

Out of scope, untouched: #32997's question 3 (rule 3's "no evidence cap" against the `reach:` admission p3). The filer's reading (a) stands until the maintainer rules.

## Acceptance notes

- Readers of rule 3's hold, swept on `origin/main` d4fbb4db: `git grep` for 「Priority」, 〈Priority〉, "rule 3", 第 3 条, 工具卡, "tooling card", "open P0" and "undispatched P0" across `.claude`, `scripts/pm`, `skills` and `AGENTS.md`. Two readers of the hold: `execution-duties.md` line 50 (the take precondition) and `triage-duties.md` line 63 (triage's first-touch close of a door-less `tooling` card). The first sweep missed the second, because that line names the hold by its condition and not by 「Priority」 or 第 3 条; contract review 6879988263 found it, and round 1 adds its pointer. `filing-gate.md` 〈定级判据〉 and `triage-duties.md` line 60 read the grading rules, not the hold. No `scripts/pm/**` code implements the hold (the `tooling` label's candidate-query consumer in `ensure-pm-labels.sh` filters on `Unblocks:` or a named surface, not on lane P0/P1), so no code or self-test changes.
- `ROADMAP.md` line 13 says only "the first step that breaks is the current P0", which still agrees; it is not edited.
- `pm:blocking` stays derived from the `Blocked-by:` reverse index (`dispatch-runbook.md` line 8); the exemption names the `Blocked-by:` line, so it reads the same index and needs no new label or state.
- Serial constraint: #33157 (same lane, this round) may touch `execution-duties.md`; whichever lands second merges `origin/main` and re-runs the ratchet.
